title: FJAAK DJ set |  Mixmag Cover Mix
description:
FJAAK take us on a "lovingly curated journey" through throwback and cutting-edge techno

"Our latest mix is a lovingly curated journey through groovy but driving techno with a strong '90s influence. It features many unreleased tracks from us and other talented artists, ensuring a unique listening experience. We've carefully selected each track to capture the energy and innovation of that era, while also pushing boundaries with modern production techniques. A lot of the tracks come from our latest album, 'FJAAK THE SYSTEM'. This mix is dedicated to explore the genre's rich history while discovering fresh and contemporary sounds."

Read the cover feature here: https://mixmag.net/feature/fjaak-the-system-cover-feature-interview-berlin-techno
Read the tracklist here: https://mixmag.net/feature/the-cover-mix-fjaak-dj-berlin-techno
